5 to 15 customer interviews, and the churned ones

Your security review answered in writing, before the first call
Your connections, your notes and your target’s files each have a rule, and the rule is enforced by the architecture, not by a promise.

A vault that agents cannot read
Term sheets and partner notes live in a vault we host and cannot read, encrypted in your browser. Prefer Obsidian? A plugin keeps them there
European hosting and model routing restricted to European regions, for funds whose data must stay in Europe.
Agents have no tool that sends, posts or emails. They draft. Every export and every outreach is yours to approve.
All our expertise, written into open methods. The platform runs them; you can run them yourself.
40 years combined operating at scale, at PayPal, Amazon, Safran, Decathlon and more. Four continents. Based in Paris and London.
Run it yourself today, or tell us about the deal and we will scope it with you.
